create.name: Sri Aurobindo Sadhana Peetham
create.bio:
Sri Aurobindo Sadhana Peetham is a small residential ashram devoted to Sri Aurobindo's and the Mother's Integral Yoga, set on a three-acre homestead among the vineyards just west of Lodi in California's Central Valley. It took its present name in 1993, when the community reorganised itself as a collective ashram, and it keeps relics of Sri Aurobindo in a meditation hall modelled on the atmosphere of the Samadhi in Pondicherry. Members live and work on the property, and their work includes running Auromère, which distributes the books of Sri Aurobindo and the Mother.

The ashram follows the Pondicherry ashram's few rules and treats daily work as the main field of practice, so its outward programme is modest. Evenings bring meditation and study groups on Savitri, The Synthesis of Yoga and Essays on the Gita, with one group meeting online, and on the third Saturday of each month it hosts a day-long retreat for the wider Integral Yoga community, led by a different volunteer each time. Darshan days are marked with special meditations. Visitors can sit in the meditation hall and gardens by arrangement, take a single room for a short stay, or apply to live there for sustained sadhana. There is also a library of more than 5,000 books and recordings.

courses.title: Monthly community retreats and study groups
courses.description: A day-long retreat on the third Saturday of each month with talks, reading, group meditation, sharing, karma yoga and shared meals, each on a theme chosen by its facilitator. Evening meditation and study groups on Sri Aurobindo's major works meet through the week, one of them on Zoom.

courses.title: Visits and short guest stays
courses.description: The gardens, meditation hall and relics room are open to visitors by arrangement, and single rooms are available for short stays. Guests cook for themselves in a vegetarian kitchen and are invited to help with the ashram's work.

courses.title: Residential sadhana
courses.description: For people who want to give their lives to the Integral Yoga, the ashram offers collective residence with board and a field of work, under the rules Sri Aurobindo and the Mother set for their ashram in Pondicherry. Enquire through the contact form.
